title: ECB says digital euro app will exceed EU accessibility standards
summary: The European Central Bank proposed accessibility standards for its planned digital euro app, saying it would be one of several ways users could access basic digital euro services.

title: Aave weighs closing 6 V3 blockchain markets, offboarding 50 low-use reserves
